Description: Infection of susceptible humans through bites by infectious mosquitoes.
Progression of exposed humans to the symptomatic infectious state at an age-specific rate k(a) with probability ρ.
Progression of exposed humans to the asymptomatic infectious state at an age-specific rate k(a) with probability 1-ρ.
Recovery of symptomatic infectious humans at an age-specific rate γ_1(a).
Recovery of asymptomatic infectious humans at an age-specific rate γ_2(a).
Reinfection of asymptomatic humans by infectious mosquitoes, causing them to become symptomatic infectious.
Infection of susceptible mosquitoes by biting symptomatic or asymptomatic infectious humans.

Name: B
Description: The constant influx rate of the human hosts.

Name: μ_h
Description: The natural death rate of the human hosts.

Name: μ_v
Description: The natural death rate of the mosquitoes.

Name: γ_1(a)
Description: The age-specific recovery rate of symptomatic infectious hosts.

Name: γ_2(a)
Description: The age-specific recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious hosts.

Name: β_v(a)
Description: The age-specific transmission rate from infectious humans to susceptible mosquitoes.

Name: β_h(a)
Description: The age-specific transmission rate from infected mosquitoes to susceptible humans.

Name: ρ
Description: The probability of exposed hosts transferring to symptomatic infectious hosts.

Name: σ
Description: The factor characterizing the intensity of reinfection of asymptomatic infectious hosts, and their relative infectiousness to mosquitoes.
